Supersedes steer e1224403 (one experiment per view). Jack Heart, 2026-11-23: "the local server has minimal value if its only one experiment", "i dont want to download a ton of data onto my local laptop", "we can re-evaluate local vs server once the trainer is pushing data", "so mostly lets just check in somethign reasonable and get to the pushing data version". So: do not scope the view to one experiment; revert any change made for that. Keep the view reading its source as it did at 33dfdfd. Finish the breadcrumbs (steer fb67f5d5). In the docs for `etude view`, say plainly that a bucket source is read in full into the local cache before runs appear, so it suits this computer's runs and small sources, and that a pushed, hosted view is the planned path for large buckets (Task fdba33). No new filters, windows or flags. Then gate and publish; this PR should land soon so fdba33 (stacked on it) can build the push version.
